name: AI assistant
author: Brett
description: The framework's assistant (assistant@1) in the Dev Console: every provider in the shared registry (Anthropic, Claude Code subscription, OpenAI, xAI Grok, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Together, Fireworks, Perplexity, Cohere, Cerebras, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, any OpenAI-compatible server), setup wizard in Settings → Plugins → AI assistant, settings dialog inside the chat, live sessions on an open host registry, write-mode approval cards, the Claude Code MCP bridge. Chats as an agent from an installed agent manager. Hub users (behind axHub's sign-in wall) chat at /api/plugins/ai-assistant/app with permissions from the hub's users page.

builtWith.rebuildOf: Opus build of Oct 18 2026 (pending item ai-assistant-plugin)
